name: simple_fsm_bench2
description: Evaluates models' understanding and manipulation of simple finite state machines (FSMs), including tasks such as state reachability, transition prediction, acceptance testing, and constructing FSMs from descriptions. Instances require symbolic/structural reasoning and sometimes programmatic output (e.g., transition tables or code) to demonstrate correct behavior. Designed to probe formal reasoning and basic automata-related problem solving.
reputation: Small, specialized research dataset with limited adoption outside automata/ML reasoning experiments.
